items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: Professor William Nickerson, he taught me violin. I take violin lessons from Professor William Nickerson.

ctx.x: That's it. Oh, you'd all sing it once or one at a time?
I'd sing it just one at a time. And Professor William Nickerson, he taught me violin. I take violin lessons from Professor William Nickerson.
Was that at Southern or at Fifth?
